patch_description: Fundamentally different approach: replace the Kalman/RTS machinery with an ℓ1 total-variation (TV) trend filter solved by Condat's fast primal-dual algorithm. TV denoising is the classic solution to exactly this problem class: it produces piecewise-linear estimates with the minimum number of slope changes, directly optimizing slope-change and false-reversal metrics, while its edge-preserving property avoids the lag/oversmoothing trade-off that penalizes Kalman and moving-average filters. A small trend-gated lead compensation (advancing the estimate along its own piecewise slope) offsets the residual smoothing lag, boosting responsiveness. TV filtering is O(n), robust to non-stationarity (no stationarity assumption, no noise model required beyond a scale estimate), and the convex formulation guarantees a unique, stable solution. The output contract (length n - window_size + 1, end-aligned) is preserved exactly.
